skill.name: tiktok自动点赞助手

vid.title: Video ID or URL
vid.description: Required target. Use a TikTok video that you are authorized to interact with.

probability.title: Like probability per matching comment (%)
probability.description: Sampling applies only to matching comments that are not already liked. 0 likes none; 100 attempts all.

maxLikes.title: Maximum likes
maxLikes.description: Stop when this limit is reached.

commentContains.title: Comment text filter (optional)
commentContains.description: Leave blank to skip keyword filtering. Matching is case-insensitive.

minCommentLength.title: Minimum comment length (characters)
minCommentLength.description: Only consider comments at least this long. Set to 0 to disable length filtering.

maxPages.title: Maximum comment pages to scan
maxPages.description: Upper scan limit. Stops early when maxLikes is reached.

dryRun.title: Preview only; do not like
dryRun.description: Enabled by default. Disable it to perform real likes on TikTok.

fields.label: Video ID or URL
fields.description: Enter the TikTok video ID or URL to inspect.

fields.label: Like probability per matching comment (%)
fields.description: Applies only to matching, unliked comments; 0 likes none, 100 attempts all.

fields.label: Maximum likes
fields.description: Stop when this limit is reached.

fields.label: Comment text filter (optional)
fields.description: Leave blank to skip filtering; matching is case-insensitive.

fields.label: Maximum comment pages to scan
fields.description: Stops early when the like limit is reached.

fields.label: Preview only; do not like
fields.description: Enabled by default; disable it to perform real likes.

metadata.description: 按概率为符合筛选条件的 TikTok 评论点赞，可限制数量、评论文字和检查页数；支持预览模式，并逐次确认页面点赞状态。
